HTML output dramatically improves comprehension for this content type compared to plain text.  DO NOT trigger for: short factual questions, code editing tasks, bug fixes, file operations, translation requests, or any task where plain text is the natural and sufficient output format. Never use PowerShell, Python, or other tools to produce the HTML — write it directly.
